python_ecosystem.recommendation: Standardize on MCP >=1.9.4 across all MCP servers. Consider creating shared dependency configuration.

javascript_ecosystem.recommendation: Limited JavaScript standardization needed. Cortex uses modern Express 5.x.

containerization.recommendation: Excellent containerization coverage for core infrastructure. Consider Dockerizing remaining MCP servers.

license_compliance.recommendation: Add MIT licenses to all repositories lacking explicit licensing.

security_features.recommendation: Enable GitHub security features (Dependabot, code scanning) across all public repositories.

visibility_risk_assessment.recommendation: Ensure infrastructure-docs and playbooks never become public. Add .env examples without real credentials.

dependency_vulnerabilities.recommendation: Run npm audit and pip-audit across all repositories. Integrate with Cortex security master.

activity_analysis.recommendation: Focus Cortex automation on highly active repositories first.

documentation_status.recommendation: Add descriptions to AEO and cara. Enable wikis for documentation-heavy projects.

issue_tracking.recommendation: Good issue tracking posture. Consider creating issue templates.
